indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_mv_anime_score_cold_v1 ON public.mv_anime_top_rated USING btree (COALESCE(average_score, 0) DESC, id DESC) WHERE ((COALESCE(is_adult, false) = false) AND (NOT ('Hentai'::text = ANY (COALESCE(genres, '{}'::text[])))) AND (NOT ('Ecchi'::text = ANY (COALESCE(genres, '{}'::text[])))) AND (COALESCE(format, ''::text) <> ALL (ARRAY['SPECIAL'::text, 'MUSIC'::text, 'TV_SHORT'::text])))
indexes.name: idx_mv_anime_score_cold_v1
